---
description: Prepare README, architecture note, and honest delivery checklist.
---

Prepare the project documentation and delivery checklist based on the actual implementation.

README must include:
- prerequisites;
- Windows PowerShell setup commands;
- environment variables and `.env.example`;
- database initialization/migrations;
- how to start frontend, backend, and worker;
- how to run tests;
- how to load the supplied data pack;
- how to access candidate and HR demo flows;
- known limitations and mock components.

Also create a concise architecture note describing components, data flow, authorization boundaries, scoring lifecycle, persistence, and key trade-offs.

Before documenting a feature as complete, verify it exists. Clearly label mocked, optional, incomplete, and untested features. Do not include real credentials, API keys, personal tokens, or private candidate data.
